scope: Fresh source-only peer review of Scrape role and width selection for one guarded hosted native run. No browser, database, release, build, or native execution.

verdict_a.bounded_run_readiness: Member with normal emulated panel width is source-ready for one guarded native run; the admin cell is not ready under the selected-organization requirement. No native health is established by this review.
passed_source_checks: Workflow invokes mode, width, and credential preflight before browser setup; malformed member/admin credentials and invalid width selections are refused.

Member path uses first-party magic-link identity, canonical non-admin check, extension profile match, rendered role, and selected organization UUID/name before Scrape, then rechecks identity and organization in the replacement panel.

Normal mode applies CDP viewport emulation to the owned SIDE_PANEL target on warm and replacement panels and requires measured innerWidth to meet the requested minimum. The receipt names emulation, not a Chrome divider resize.

Exact artifact provenance and hash verification, resource guard, hosted Profile durable-recovery refusal, private credential staging and cleanup, and guest storage checks remain on their existing paths.

open_targets.finding: Admin sign-in records stored.organizationId without requiring a selected UUID/name. currentSettingsIdentityMatches expressly accepts a null organization when none is rendered. A direct negative check returned NULL_ADMIN_ORG_ACCEPTED=true. Thus an admin warm/reload receipt can claim identity verification with no selected organization; the member path does select and verify one.

The Scrape receipt remains partial when other roles or cases are open, and partial exits zero. This behavior predates the reviewed commit. A green workflow means the selected run completed, not that the Scrape feature or all role-width cells passed. The exact case results and remaining list must be read from the receipt.

cannot_verify: Actual member/admin authentication, normal emulated width, warm/reload Scrape controls, resource health, and secret cleanup on a hosted runner require a guarded native run.
CDP emulation cannot establish Chrome's native divider resize behavior.

quality_evidence: New selection logic is a small shared helper used by both hosted wrapper and native driver; existing authentication and resource primitives are reused.
Receipt removes raw profile ID, email, and organization ID from the authentication summary; private files are staged mode 0600 and removed after child completion.
Focused tests cover malformed selections, credentials, provenance routes, width observation, and Settings identity conditions.
limits: The new viewport test's fake panel assigns observed width from the requested CDP argument, so green does not prove Chrome changes innerWidth; the native run is the forcing evidence.
No focused test asserts that an admin identity must have a selected organization, matching the source gap in Verdict A.
No new consumer promotes partial receipt to full feature health was found in the reviewed diff; the pre-existing zero exit on partial requires receipt-aware interpretation.

executed_checks.syntax: node --check on hosted wrapper, native Scrape driver, and Settings auth driver: passed
executed_checks.negative_admin_org: Direct call to currentSettingsIdentityMatches with valid admin identity fields and organizationId=null, organizationSelected=false returned true
